key_share_what: What happened: Google Antigravity's 5h and weekly caps do not scale proportionally — 2–3 heavy 5h blocks can exhaust 100% of the weekly quota. On top of that, the entire Gemini 4 family (Neon / Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon) suffers from intermittent prompt-cache drops (cache_read_tokens = 0), re-billing the whole context from scratch. Google expanded Neon's cache pool and reset quotas on Nov 20–21, 2026, yet shard routing, mid-session model/effort switches, and idle timeouts still trigger drops.
key_share_why: Why I use Gemini less: Long agent loops and multi-turn tool calls burn through the weekly cap unpredictably on Gemini; I rely on Claude Code / Codex for main daily work and keep Gemini for scoped tasks or high-CP spots.
key_share_tip: How to save quota when using it: Start a fresh session (or /compact) when switching tasks, and avoid changing models or thinking effort mid-conversation.
plan_split:
Official native subagent dispatch (fresh context by default; reviewer / security never fork):

Codex: spawn_agent dispatches parallel subagents (default_subagent_model stays gpt-6.2-sol).
Antigravity: invoke_subagent runs subagents in the background with a clean context.
